name: Darkmaster Gandling
summary: Darkmaster Gandling is the mortal headmaster of Scholomance, overseeing the instruction and training of necromancers for the Cult of the Damned. Operating from the depths of the ruined Keep of Caer Darrow, he serves the Scourge by orchestrating gruesome magical experiments upon the living and dead alike.

sections.title: The Headmaster's Domain
sections.body: Within the dark halls beneath Caer Darrow, Darkmaster Gandling governs Scholomance, the premier academy for the Scourge's aspiring necromancers. A living human serving the Cult of the Damned, Gandling worked alongside the lich Ras Frostwhisper to orchestrate atrocities against countless innocent captives taken from the surrounding lands. Students who enter his classrooms are instructed in plague brewing, reanimation, and flesh sculpting.

sections.title: Master of the Reliquary
sections.body: Residing deep within the Headmaster's Study, Gandling commands the dark relics and spirits trapped inside the ancient school. He wields devastating arcane and shadow magic in conjunction with forbidden necromantic arts, cursing intruders and hurling them through shadow portals into the sealed chambers surrounding his study, where they must fight alone against the risen dead while Gandling shields himself from harm.

faq.answer: Darkmaster Gandling is a human necromancer belonging to the Cult of the Damned. He acts as the headmaster of Scholomance, running the dark school and training new necromancers to serve the Lich King.

faq.q: Is Gandling an undead or a living human?
faq.answer: Despite his mastery of death magic and allegiance to the Scourge, Gandling remains a living human mortal. He leads mortal acolytes and cultists within Scholomance, serving the Scourge willingly.

faq.q: What is his connection to Ras Frostwhisper?
faq.answer: Ras Frostwhisper was Gandling's teacher. Together, the human headmaster and the powerful lich established Scholomance as the center of dark instruction and supervised the horrors committed against innocent souls such as the Sarkhoffs within Caer Darrow.
Gandling resides in the Headmaster's Study at the very bottom of Scholomance, accessible through the catacombs beneath Caer Darrow in Darrowmere Lake.

angles.text: Gandling represents the ultimate corruption of Dalaran's scholarly traditions, twisting academic rigor into a horrifying factory of undeath.
For the Forsaken, Gandling is a hated overseer of Scourge indoctrination who binds free souls into eternal enslavement beneath Caer Darrow.
